[s] klI, (rajyate rajatIti । ranj + “BUraYjiByAM kit .” uRA॰ 4 । 216 । ityasun .) strIRAM mAsi mAsi yoniniHsftaraktam । tatparyyAyaH । puzpam 2 Arttavam 3 । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 21 ॥ ftuH 4 kusumam 5 rajam 6 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, manO । 5 । 108 । “rajasA strI manoduzwA sannyAsena dbijottamaH ॥” asya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “raYjitAstejasA tvApaH SarIrasTena dehinAm । avyApannAH prasannena raktamityaBiDIyate ॥ rasAdeva striyA raktaM rajaHsaMjYaM pravarttate । tadbarzAdbAdaSAdUrdDvaM yAti paYcASataH kzayam ॥” “nArIRAM rajasi copacIyamAne SanEH SanEH stanagarBASayayonyaBivfdDirBavati .” iti suSrute sUtrasTAne 14 aDyAyaH ॥ “mAsi mAsi rajaHstrIRAM rasajaM sravati tryaham । vatsarAddvAdaSAdUrdDaM yAti paYcASataH kzayam ॥” iti vABawe SArIrasTAne praTame'DyAye ॥) prakfterguRaviSezaH । tattu rAgadvezAtmakaM duHKahetuH । rajo'dantaH puMliNgo'pi । yaTA, -- “rajo'yaM rajasA sArdDaM strIpuzpaguRaDUlizu .” ityamaradattaH । iti BarataH ॥ mahABAratamate duHKajanakaguRaH । tasya DarmmaH kAmaH kroDaH loBaH mAnaH darpaSca । iti mokzaDarmmaH ॥ “tfzRA kroDo'BisaMramBo rAjasAste guRAH smftAH ॥” aBisaMramBo dbezABiniveSaH । ityASvameDikaparvva ॥ api ca । “kAma eza kroDa eza rajoguRasamudBavaH । mahASano mahApApmA vidDyenamiha vEriRam ॥” iti SrIBagavadgItAyAm । 2 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । “sattvaM rajastama iti guRAH prakftisamBavAH । nibaDnanti mahAbAho dehe dehinamavyayam ॥” “rajo rAgAtmakaM vidDi tfzRAsaNgasamudBavam । tannibaDnAti kOnteya ! karmmasaNgena dehinam ॥” “sattvaM suKe saYjayati rajaH karmmaRi BArata । jYAnamAvftya tu tamaH pramAde saYjayatyuta ॥ rajastamaScABiBUya sattvaM Bavati BArata । rajaH sattvaM tamaScEva tamaH sattvaM rajastaTA ॥” “loBaH pravfttirAramBaH karmmaRAmasamaH spfhA । rajasyetAni jAyante vivfdDa BaratarzaBa ! ॥” “karmmaRaH sukftasyAhuH sAttvikaM nirmmalaM Palam । rajasastu PalaM duHKamajYAnaM tamasaH Palam ॥ sattvAt saYjAyate jYAnaM rajaso loBa eva ca । pramAdamohO tamaso Bavato'jYAnameva ca ॥ UrdDvaM gacCanti sattvasTA maGye tizWanti rAjasAH । jaGanyaguRavfttisTA aDo gacCanti tAmasAH ॥” iti SrIBagavadgItAyAm । 14 aDyAyaH ॥ “sattvaM rajastama iti dfSyante puruze guRAH । kAlasaYcoditAste'pi parivarttanta Atmani ॥ praBUtaYca yadA sattvaM manobudDIndriyARi ca । tadA kftayugaM vidyAddAne tapasi yadratiH ॥ yadA karmmasu kAryyezu SaktiryaSasi dehinAm । tadA tretA rajovfdDiriti jAnIhi SOnaka ॥ yadA loBastvasantozo mAno damBo'Ta matsaraH । karmmaRAYcApi kAmyAnAM dbAparaM tadrajastamaH ॥ yadA sadAnftaM tandrI nidrA hiMsAdisADanam । SokamohaBayaM dEnyaM sa kalistu tadA smftaH ॥” iti gAruqe 227 aDyAyaH ॥ parAgaH । iti medinI । se, 32 ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 4 । 24 । 22 । “padmakoSarajo dikzu vikzipatpavanotsavam ॥”) reRuH । asya paryyAyaH DUliSabde drazwavyaH ॥ (yaTA, mAGe । 2 । 46 । “pAdAhataM yadutTAya mUrdDAnamaDirohati । svasTAdevApamAne'pi dehinastadbasaM rajaH ॥”) nizidDAnizidDarajo yaTA, -- “AyuzkAmo na seveta taTA sammArjjanIrajaH । taTASvaraTaDAnyAnAM gavAYcEva rajaH SuBam ॥ aSuBaYca vijAnIyAt KarozwrAjAvrikezu ca । gavAM rajo DAnyarajaH puttrasyANgaBavaM rajaH ॥ etadrajo mahASastaM mahApAtakanASanam । ajArajaH Kararajo yattu sammArjjanIrajaH ॥ etadrajo mahApApaM mahAkilvizakAraRam ॥” iti gAruqe 114 aDyAyaH ॥ (rAtriH । iti niGaRwuH । 1 । 7 ॥ udakam । yaTA, fgvede । 1 । 56 । 5 । “viyattiroDaruRamacyutaM rajotizWipo diva AtAsu barhaRA .” ‘raja udakam .’ iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥ Buvanam । yaTA, tatrEva । 10 । 82 । 4 । “asUrtte sUrtte rajasi nizatte ye BUtAni samakfRvannimAni .” “rajasi loke .” iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥ jyotiH । yaTA, tatrEva । 10 । 32 । 2 । “vIndra yAsi divyAni rocanA vipArTivAni rajasA puruzwuta .” “rajasA AtmIyena jyotizA । vidyullakzaRena yadvA rajaHSabdAcCasa AkAraH pArTivAn lokAn .” iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥)
v: na॰ ranja--ka । 1 strIkusume Sabdara॰ । 2 parAge 3 reRO 4 guRaBede ca pu॰ jAnte Sabdaca॰ ।

the pollen of flowers, Prasaṅgābh.
the menstrual excretion (also n.), L.
emotion, affection, L. : the quality of passion, Uṇ. iv, 216, Sch.

of a king (son of Viraja), VP.

pl. dust, Ragh.

[रज्यतेऽत्र, रंज्-कनि वा ङीप्] 1 Night; हरिरभिमानी रजनिरिदानीमियमपि याति विरामं Gīt. 5. --2 Turmeric. --3 Red lac. --4 N. of Durgā. --Comp. --करः {1} the moon. {2} camphor. --चरः {1} a nightstalker, demon, goblin. {2} a thief. {3} a night-watcher. {4} N. of the moon. --जलं night-dew, hoar-frost. --पतिः, --रमणः the moon. --मुखं nightfall, evening.

m: रजस् n. ‘coloured or dim space’, the sphere of vapour or mist, region of clouds, atmosphere, air, firmament (in Veda one of the divisions of the world and distinguished from दिव् or स्वर्, ‘the sphere of light’, and रोचना दिवः, ‘the ethereal spaces’, which are beyond the रजस्, as ether is beyond the air; often रजस् = ‘the whole expanse of heaven or sky’, divided into a lower and upper stratum, the रजस् उपरम् or पार्थिवम् and the रजस् उत्तमम् or परमम् or दिव्यम्; hence du. रजसी, ‘the lower and higher atmospheres’; sometimes also three and RV. i, 164, 6 even six such spheres are enumerated, hence pl. रजांसि, ‘the skies’), RV.; AV.; TS.; VS.; Br.
vapour, mist, clouds, gloom, dimness, darkness, RV.; AV.
impurity, dirt, dust, any small particle of matter, RV. &c. &c. (cf. गो-र्˚)
the dust or pollen of flowers, Kālid.; BhP.
cultivated or ploughed land (as ‘dusty’ or ‘dirty’), arable land, fields, RV.
the impurity i.e. the menstrual discharge of a woman, GṛS.; Mn.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
the ‘darkening’ quality, passion, emotion, affection, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

(in phil.) the second of the three Guṇas or qualities (the other two being सत्त्व, goodness, and तमस्, darkness; cf. IW. 85; रजस् is sometimes identified with तेजस्, q.v.; it is said to predominate in air, and to be active, urgent, and variable), Sāṃkhyak.; VarBṛS.; Suśr. &c.
‘light’ or ‘day’ or ‘world’ or ‘water’, Nir. iv, 19
a kind of plant (= पर्पट), Bhpr.
tin, L.
autumn, L.
sperm, L.
safflower, L.
रजस् m. N. of a Ṛṣi (son of Vasiṣṭha), VP.
रजस् [cf. Gk. ἔ-ρεβος; Goth. riqis.]
a: रजस् — n. [रंज्-असुन् नलोपः] 1 Dust, powder, dirt; धन्यास्तदंगरजसां मलिनीभवंति Ś. 7. 17; आत्मोद्धतैरपि रजोभिरलंघनीयाः 1. 8; R. 1. 42; 6. 33. --2 The dust or pollen of flowers; भूयात्कुशेशयरजोमृदुरेणुरस्याः (पंथाः) Ś. 4. 10; Me. 33, 65. --3 A mote in a sun-beam, any small particle (of matter); cf. Ms. 8. 132 and Y. 1. 362. --4 A ploughed or cultivated land, arable field. --5 Gloom, darkness. --6 Foulness, passion, emotion, moral or mental darkness; अपथे पदमर्पयंति हि श्रुतवंतोऽपि रजोनिमीलिताः R. 9. 74. --7 The second of the three Guṇas or constituent qualities of all material substances (the other two being सत्त्व and तमस्; रजस् is supposed to be the cause of the great activity seen in creatures; it predominates in men, as Sattva and Tamas predominate in gods and demons); अंतर्गतमपास्तं मे रजसोपि परं तमः Ku. 6. 60; Bg. 6. 27; रजोजुषे जन्मनि K.; Māl. 1. 20. --8 Menstrual discharge, menses; Ms. 4. 41; 5. 66. --9 Safflower. --10 Tin. --11 Ved. Air, atmosphere. --12 A division of the world. --13 Vapour. --14 Cloud or rain-water. --Comp. --गुणः see (7) above. --तमस्क a. being under the influence of both rajas and tamas. --तोकः --कं, --पुत्रः {1} greediness, avarice. {2} ‘the child of passion’, a term applied to a person to show that he is quite insignificant. --दर्शनं the first appearance of the menstrual excretion, first menstrual flow. --निमीलित a. blinded by passion; R. 9. 74. --पटलं a coating of dust. --बंधः suppression of menstruation. --रसः, --वलं darkness. --शुद्धिः f. pure condition of the menses. --हरः ‘dirt-remover’. a washerman.

of an Āṅgirasa, ĀrṣBr.
of a son of Āyu, MBh.

रजि (accord. to some also, ‘straight, erect, upright’).

रजिका f. a washerwoman, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 145; Pat.

a: रज्जूकृ — {c8c} U. To use as a rope; as in सर्पं रज्जूकरोति.

m: रज्जु f. (ifc. sometimes m.; in earlier language also f(रज्जू). ; Ved. acc. रज्ज्वम्; gen. रज्ज्वास्, Mn. xi, 168; probably fr. an unused √ रस्ज्, or रज्ज्; cf. रसना = रशना) a rope, cord, string, line, RV. &c. &c. (रज्जुम् आ-√ स्था, to have recourse to the rope, to hang one's self, MBh.)
N. of partic. sinews or tendons proceeding from the vertebral column, Suśr.
a lock of braided hair, braid (= वेणी), L.
N. of a partic. constellation, VarBṛS.

a: रज्जुः — f. 1 A rope, cord, string. --2 N. of a sinew proceeding from the vertebral column. --3 A lock of braided hair. --Comp. --दालकः a kind of wild fowl; so रज्जुवालः. --पेडा a rope-basket.

= next, Viṣṇ.; Mn.
